capabilities: create a note with a random word prompt via ribbon button or command
run a countdown timer that switches the note to read mode when it ends
customize note name format, file path, tag, and timer through settings
extras: Planned features listed as not yet implemented: note templates, custom word lists, and daily note integration.
motivation: The author learned object writing from Pat Pattison and wanted a quick way to run the exercise in Obsidian.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to run timed object writing sessions with random word prompts.
summary: Writing-exercise plugin that creates a new note with a random word prompt and a countdown timer for object writing practice.
